title: Pixel Racer
description: Race through pixel-packed tracks, dodge obstacles, and reach the finish line as fast as possible!
how_to_play:
1. Press Play to start the race.
2. Use arrow keys to steer your car.
3. Avoid obstacles and other racers.
4. Collect power-ups for boosts.
5. Try to finish each track with the best time!

Tips:
- Master the corners for faster lap times.
- Collect boost items to gain speed advantages.
